## Context / Problem
13 MB of research artefacts (65 `.py`, 39 md, 36 jsonl, 30 json, 17 yaml) live under `docs/experiments/`, and `docs/calibration/` holds 4 notes plus `plan_v5_rescore.py`. Living under `docs/` makes them docs-tooling link-check targets and is the ONLY reason CodeQL skips them. Packaging is confirmed non-shipping: wheel `packages = ["src/rebar"]` (`pyproject.toml:363-367`), sdist `include` (`:391`), no `MANIFEST.in`. `scripts/check_docs_index.py` indexes `docs/*.md` (`:70-88`) and link-checks `docs` recursively (`:103`), so after the move it stops seeing the tree. Cites verified on `aa37a738570`.

## Approach
`git mv docs/experiments evals && git mv docs/calibration evals/calibration` (history preserved), then repoint every live reference OUTSIDE the moved tree.

**The moved tree's own contents are frozen as authored and are NOT repointed.** 61 files / 157 lines inside `docs/experiments/**` and `docs/calibration/**` embed the literal old paths — harness scripts, run artefacts (`runs/*.jsonl`, `*.json`), eval-spec fixtures and research notes. Those strings record what was actually executed, so rewriting them would falsify the research record, exactly as for `docs/archive/`. `evals/` is therefore excluded from the AC2 grep.

**The worklist is the Testing grep, not a hand-kept list.** Three successive hand enumerations each missed live references, so the plan defines the target by that command and AC2 enforces it. Current content: 34 hits in 21 test files and the non-test sites below.

- **`rebar.toml`** `:51` (a `docs/calibration/completion_floor.md` comment), `:216` (comment) and `:220` (`[llm.evals] corpus_root`, which flips to `"evals"`).
- **`.gitignore`** `:19`, `:122` (a comment naming `replay/corpus-*.manifest.json`) and `:123`.
- **CodeQL — load-bearing, not cosmetic.** `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml`'s whole ignore list is `docs/**` (`:8-9`); the `docs/experiments` string it once named is gone. The research tree is excluded ONLY by living under `docs/`, so moving it to a top-level `evals/` drops it out of that umbrella and CodeQL would start scanning the 65 research `.py` files. `evals/**` must be added under `paths-ignore` in THIS change.
- **Live docs under `docs/`** (neither historical nor previously enumerated): `architecture.md:312`, `plan-review-gate.md:126,142,198,281,473,1537,1562,1804`, `remediation-implementation-plan.md:180,188,306`, `review-kernel.md:35`, and `README.md:129` (experiment links) and `:141` (calibration links). `docs/plan-review-criteria-guide.md:8` is GENERATED from `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_A1.md:10`; repoint the reviewer source and regenerate rather than editing the guide.
- **Source and packaged data**: `src/rebar/llm/reviewers/plan_review_A1.md:10` ("a path under `evals/` (formerly `docs/experiments/`)"); `src/rebar/llm/code_review/criteria_routing.json` `_comment`s at `:4,92,112,158,189,197,205`; `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_advisory.py:164` and `det_operator_attested.py:11`; `src/rebar/llm/evals/plan_replay/corpus.py:5` and `legacy_v4_baseline.py:2-6`; `src/rebar/llm/config_readers.py` (the `[llm.evals]` comment); the six eval-spec comments plus `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/README.plan-review.md:67`; `scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py:45`, `scripts/check_dco_identity.py:30`, `scripts/calibrate_completion_floor.py:9`.
- **NOT repointed because they carry no such string** (verified): `src/rebar/grounding/resolve.py` and `src/rebar/llm/structured.py` have zero `docs/experiments`/`docs/calibration` matches; `tests/unit/gold_set_completion.py` likewise. All three are dropped from the worklist.
- **Tests** — 21 files, 34 hits, the complete current grep output. Path loaders: `test_criterion_effectiveness.py:16`, `test_e6_agreement.py:5,16`, `test_gate_eval_classifier.py:3,17`, `test_derive_code_review_threshold.py:12`, `test_impact_model_versioning.py:41,146` (TWO loaders — `:146` targets `ab_impact_model.py`), `test_ac_process_gate_criterion.py:118`, `test_asserted_capability_criterion.py:115`, `test_decomp_shape_criterion.py:179`, `test_necessity_criterion.py:98`, `test_project_failure_disposition_contract.py:222`, `test_t15_overlay_derisk_criterion.py:156`, `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_corpus.py:5`, `tests/unit/workflow/test_interpreter_v2.py:4`. String asserters: `test_transition_force_flag_24f7.py:148,149,150,153`, `test_check_criteria_vocabulary.py:169,210`, `test_check_dco_identity.py:6,110`, `test_classify_gerrit_verify_change.py:57,58`, `test_canonical.py:83`, `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py:25`. Two carry load-bearing couplings: `test_code_review_criteria_routing.py:140` asserts `superseded_by == "docs/experiments/code-review-threshold-calibration-code-v5.md"` and must move in step with `criteria_routing.json:4,158`; `tests/interfaces/contracts/test_removed_cli_verbs_heldout.py:44` holds a `_HISTORY_PREFIXES` entry `docs/experiments/` that becomes a stale prefix once the live tree leaves that path — repoint it to `evals/` and keep the old prefix only if the history scan still needs it.
- **Sequencing on `d279` (`disgusted-fretful-hare`, closed).** It added `tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py::test_no_hard_coded_roots`, which asserts `corpus.py` is the SOLE `docs/experiments` match under `src/rebar/llm/evals` (its AC1). Repointing `corpus.py:5` here empties that grep and fails the assertion, so this change updates that test to expect no matches. Also new in `d279` and in scope: `tests/unit/evals/test_plan_replay_cli_paths.py` (module docstring) and `config_readers.py` above.
- `evals/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py` keeps importing `rebar.llm.evals.plan_replay.legacy_v4_baseline` (research-to-src, unchanged); `legacy_v4_baseline.py` stays the importable home of the v4 formula because `evals/` is not on `sys.path`.

## Scope
The moved trees; `rebar.toml`; `.gitignore`; `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml`; the 3 scripts, the source/packaged-data files, the live docs, and the 20 test files enumerated above. Parent epic `e47b` AC2 carries the identical historical carve-outs, so leaf and parent agree. Deliberately NOT repointed: the moved tree's own 157 internal references (frozen as authored, above), `docs/adr/` (6 refs), `docs/archive/`, `docs/research/`, `CHANGELOG.md`, `docs/release-notes.md`, `tests/fixtures/`, and generated `.test_durations`. AC2's grep excludes exactly that set.

## Testing
`python scripts/check_docs_index.py`; `python scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py`; `python evals/calibration/plan_v5_rescore.py --root=.`; `python -m rebar.llm.plan_review.registry regenerate-criteria-guide` (the guide is GENERATED and must not be hand-edited); then `make verify`. Edge: `python -m build --wheel && unzip -l dist/*.whl | grep -c 'evals/'` prints `0`, sdist likewise; `git log --follow evals/plan-review-gate/replay/ledger.jsonl` shows pre-move history.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `docs/experiments` and `docs/calibration` are absent, and `evals/` contains exactly the union of the former `docs/experiments/**` and `docs/calibration/**` files — same total file count as the two trees had before the move, with `docs/calibration/**` now under `evals/calibration/**`.
- [ ] `git grep -n 'docs/experiments\|docs/calibration' -- . ':!docs/adr' ':!docs/archive' ':!docs/research' ':!CHANGELOG.md' ':!docs/release-notes.md' ':!tests/fixtures' ':!.test_durations' ':!evals'` prints nothing.
- [ ] `git diff --stat -M origin/main` shows renames plus only the edits enumerated in Approach.
- [ ] The wheel contains no `evals/` entry, and the sdist contains no `evals/` entry.
- [ ] `.github/codeql/codeql-config.yml` lists `evals/**` under `paths-ignore`.
- [ ] `git diff -U0 -- docs/README.md` has exactly two hunks (lines 129 and 141).
- [ ] `tests/unit/evals/test_evals_corpus_root.py::test_no_hard_coded_roots` passes against the moved tree.
- [ ] `make verify` exits 0.
